import csv
cool='44d6581d-51ed-5650-ad74-1bd56a16c03e'
heat='3884ddd2-55e5-5e0a-9e6a-65822409bb01'
temp='75411709-a1c3-5621-904d-b03d146bc43d'
day='2018-01-27'
from collections import defaultdict
data=defaultdict(dict)
for r in csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if r['timeseries_id'] in (cool,heat,temp):
        ts=r['timestamp']
        if ts.startswith(day):
